events.title: Tupac Shakur would have been 55
events.blurb: Remembering influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who was tragically shot in Las Vegas in 1996 and died six days later on this day.

angles.name: Tupac Legacy
angles.copy: 2Pac. Makaveli. Whatever you knew him as, Tupac Shakur's impact on music and culture is undeniable. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix would have been 84
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, the world lost a guitar legend, Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in London at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi's Enduring Sound
angles.copy: A true pioneer of the electric guitar, Jimi Hendrix left us too soon on this day in '70. His sound changed everything. What's your top Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic eleventh studio album by The Beatles, 'Abbey Road', was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Memories
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That cover, those tracks... pure genius. What's your highlight from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, born on this day in Akron, Ohio.

angles.name: Chrissie's Rock Reign
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude defined an era. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the unmistakable voice of Oasis and a British rock icon, Liam Gallagher, born on this day in Manchester.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday Bash
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher. What's the ultimate Oasis anthem that still gets you going?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem for peace, 'Imagine', was released on this day in 1975 as a single in the US.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. Its message is as powerful today as it was in '75. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: Remember Your First iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed everything. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the villains, the cars to the theme tunes, what's your ultimate 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday, born on this day in 1940 in Liverpool.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On his 86th birthday, we remember the incredible legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary British comedian, actor, and writer, John Cleese, born on this day in Weston-super-Mare.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy Gold
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to comedy icon John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us so many laughs. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A double album masterpiece – what are your hidden gems from its tracklist?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world mourned the loss of one of music's most electrifying performers, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in London.

angles.name: Freddie's Immortal Voice
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The groundbreaking sixth studio album by The Beatles, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that pushed boundaries. What's your go-to track from it?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the music world was shaken by the tragic death of John Lennon in New York City.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we lost a true visionary. John Lennon's music and message continue to echo around the world. What's his most impactful song for you?
